findings.summary: _brand star-imports _logo without _logo.__all__, leaking implementation/dependency names; package __all__ simultaneously omits the logo API.
Logo CLI docs/prog advertise python -m scikitplot.logo, but no scikitplot.logo module exists.
Eager package imports preload executable _banner/_logo modules, producing runpy already-in-sys.modules warnings on direct module execution.
Banner batch generation can skip every generation failure and return an empty mapping; main still returns success for that zero-output batch.
